```{r}
source('multiple_imputation.R')
```


## Make analysis data

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
detach("package:mice", unload=TRUE)
detach("package:conflicted", unload=TRUE)

sm_data = readr::read_csv(file = 'Data/Analysis_data.csv')
load('RData/imputed_dataset.RData')
imp1 = mice::complete(imp_list,action = 1)
sm_data$Weight_imputed = imp1$Weight_kg
sm_data$Age_imputed = imp1$Age
sm_data$Height_imputed = imp1$Height_cm
sm_data$MUAC_imputed = imp1$`Mid-Upper Arm Circumference_cm`

sm_data$log10_BUN_imputed = imp1$log10_BUN
sm_data$log10_Creatinine_imputed = imp1$log10_Creatinine
sm_data$Lactate_imputed = imp1$Lactate
sm_data$Bicarbonate_imputed = imp1$Bicarbonate_mEq_L

# select datasets with analysis pop from imputed data
imp_data = list()
for(i in 1:imp_list$m){
  xx = mice::complete(imp_list, action = i)
  xx = xx[sm_data$INCLUDE_CC_ANALYSIS, ]
  imp_data[[i]] = xx
}
rm(imp_list)
```

compute weight for age z-scores

```{r weight_for_age_zscores}
sm_data = sm_data  %>%
  mutate(sex = ifelse(SEX=='M',1,2),
         age_days = ifelse(Age_imputed<10, Age_imputed*365, NA))
sm_data =
  addWGSR(data = sm_data, sex = 'sex', 
          firstPart = 'Weight_imputed', 
          secondPart = 'age_days',index = 'wfa')

sm_data$wfaz = ifelse(sm_data$wfaz>5 | sm_data$wfaz< -6, NA, sm_data$wfaz)
sm_data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(wfaz)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= Age, y = wfaz, color=SEX))+geom_point()+geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_minimal() + xlab('Age (years)')+ylab('Weight for age z-score')+
  geom_smooth(aes(group=NA))+
  facet_wrap(~STUDY)
```



Final analysis datasets

```{r}
sm_data_analysis = sm_data %>% 
  filter(INCLUDE_CC_ANALYSIS) %>%
  mutate(Coma = ifelse(Coma_Final==1,'Yes','No'),
         Weight_category = cut(Weight_imputed, breaks = c(0,30,100), labels = c(">30","≤30"),include.lowest=T),
         Age_category = cut(Age_imputed, breaks = c(0,2,5,15,100), labels = c("≤2","(2,5]","(5,15]",">15")))

sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    Coma = as.factor(Coma),
    COUNTRY=as.factor(COUNTRY),
    SITE_STUDY=paste(SITEID, STUDY,sep = '_'),
    SITE_STUDY = as.factor(SITE_STUDY),
    BUN_ANALYSIS = !is.na(BUN),
    CREAT_ANALYSIS = !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L),
    BUN_CREAT_ANALYSIS = BUN_ANALYSIS & CREAT_ANALYSIS)

sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis %>%
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), Age_imputed, Age),
         Weight_kg = ifelse(is.na(Weight_kg), Weight_imputed, Weight_kg),
         Height_cm = ifelse(is.na(Height_cm), Height_imputed, Height_cm))
```



```{r}
save(sm_data_analysis, sm_data, file = 'RData/Analysis_dataset.RData')
```
